admission.justification: The attributed source owners must agree on the same selection, receipt and identity contract; a single location cannot preserve the obligation across its public producer and consumers.

applicability: Agent-bound Investigator starts and selected document chat discovery.
conditions: Architect permits Projects, its selected sprint or master.
Orchestrator and Manager retain their own sprint/master containment.
Leaf selections refuse before workspace or native agent creation.
exclusions: Worker, Reviewer, Curator and Investigator may start no role.
A selected Investigator does not replace the primary document Manager or Orchestrator.

evidence: test_investigator.py public six-scope and refusal tests; DocumentChat.test.tsx both master/sprint callback+refresh; server primary tests

statement: Architect, Orchestrator and Manager start an Investigator only in their admitted Projects/sprint/master scopes; a leaf selection refuses before launch and the selected panel keeps its primary Manager or Orchestrator.
